highlights: 10% discount on regular-priced items with blue tags in Metro and a 5% rebate on all merchandise and sale items. earn 0.20% cashback indirect cashback, where S$5 spent equals UNI$1, and UNI$2000 can be redeemed for S$20 vouchers, effectively providing a cashback equivalent of 0.2%.
pros: Get 10% off regular-priced items all year round at Metro.
pros: Enjoy 5% Metro$ rebates on all merchandise, including sale items at Metro.
pros: Earn UNI$1 for every S$5 spent; redeem over 1,000 rewards from dining treats to shopping vouchers.
pros: Indulge in savoury treats and discounts at over 1,000 dining establishments.
pros: 20% off regular items in Metro on your birthday month.
pros: Exclusive invites to Double Metro$ Day, events and previews.
pros: Free delivery service when you spend a minimum of S$150 nett at Metro.
cons: 10% discounts applies to regular-priced items with a blue tag.
cons: 5% rebate is awarded in the form of Metro$ based on the nett amount charged to the Metro-UOB Card.

extra.description: Embrace a new level of style and savings with the UOB Metro-UOB Card. Elevate your retail experiences with attractive discounts, exclusive rewards, and tailored privileges.
